difficulty_reason: Assumes openness fails and builds a contradiction: pick a countable dense subset E' of non-versal points without specializations, apply the infinite-sequence lemma to get x -> x_1 -> x_2 -> ... over first-order thickenings, assemble the limit object xi over R = lim R_n by strong effectiveness, descend xi to a finite-type subalgebra R', represent the isomorphism locus Z, use smoothness of Z -> U' at z_0 to split the first-order thickening U -> U' by a lift i' : U' -> Z, and pull back the universal morphism to obtain x_1 -> x, contradicting condition (3).
